ir.name: topk_pairs_gap_simpler_002
ir.intuition: Within each batch instance, build pairwise preferences by selecting the largest objective improvements (objective[j] - objective[i] above a threshold), treating i as the winner (lower objective) and j as the loser; this concentrates comparisons on clear separations while enforcing per-instance and global pair caps.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # [B, N]
    B, N = objective.shape

    gap_thr = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.0))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    per_inst_cap = int(extra.get('max_pairs_per_instance', 8))

    # gap[b, i, j] = objective[b, j] - objective[b, i]
    # Positive gap means i is better than j when lower is better.
    gap = objective[:, None, :] - objective[:, :, None]

    eye = torch.eye(N, dtype=torch.bool, device=objective.device)[None, :, :]
    valid = (gap > gap_thr) & (~eye)

    P = N * N
    gap_flat = gap.reshape(B, P)
    valid_flat = valid.reshape(B, P)

    neg_inf = torch.full((), float('-inf'), device=objective.device, dtype=objective.dtype)
    score = torch.where(valid_flat, gap_flat, neg_inf)

    k = per_inst_cap
    if k > P:
        k = P
    if k < 1:
        k = 1

    topv, topi = torch.topk(score, k=k, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False)
    keep = topv > neg_inf

    b_grid = torch.arange(B, device=objective.device, dtype=torch.long)[:, None].expand(B, k)
    b_idx = b_grid[keep]
    flat_idx = topi[keep].to(torch.long)

    winner_idx = (flat_idx // N).to(torch.long)
    loser_idx = (flat_idx % N).to(torch.long)

    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        b_idx = b_idx[:max_pairs]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[:max_pairs]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[:max_pairs]

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=(
            b_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1),
            winner_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1),
            loser_idx.to(torch.int64).reshape(-1),
        ),
        weight=None,
        meta={
            'builder': 'topk_pairs_gap_simpler',
            'gap_threshold': gap_thr,
            'max_pairs': max_pairs,
            'max_pairs_per_instance': per_inst_cap,
            'any_valid': bool(valid.any().item()),
        },
    )
